+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+
+from tenacity import Retrying, stop_after_attempt, wait_chain, wait_fixed
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("attempt,expected", [(-2, 1.5), (0, 1.5), (1, 1.5), (2, 4.0), (3, 8.5), (12, 8.5)])
+def test_plain_callable_selection(attempt, expected):
+    state = SimpleNamespace(attempt_number=attempt)
+    calls = []
+
+    def first(s, /):
+        calls.append(s)
+        return 1.5
+
+    def last(other):
+        calls.append(other)
+        return 8.5
+
+    policy = wait_chain(first, wait_fixed(4), last)
+    assert policy(state) == expected
+    assert calls == ([] if attempt == 2 else [state])
+
+
+def test_plain_chain_in_controller():
+    selected = []
+    sleeps = []
+
+    def first(s, /):
+        selected.append(s.attempt_number)
+        return 1.5
+
+    def last(other):
+        selected.append(other.attempt_number)
+        return 8.5
+
+    controller = Retrying(
+        wait=wait_chain(first, wait_fixed(4), last),
+        sleep=sleeps.append,
+        stop=stop_after_attempt(3),
+        retry_error_callback=lambda rs: "done",
+    )
+
+    def failing():
+        raise ValueError("retry")
+
+    assert controller(failing) == "done"
+    assert sleeps == [1.5, 4.0]
+    assert selected == [1, 3]
+
+
+def test_empty_chain_still_rejected():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        wait_chain()
